# Lines that must NOT parse. `tests/test_fixtures.py::test_every_malformed_line_
# is_rejected` asserts each one yields an error and no node; `hub.parsers` has no
# "tolerant" mode to accidentally accept any of these.
#
# Every line here was verified rejected by `parse_one` when this file was added.
# A line that starts parsing is a parser regression, and this file is what turns
# it into a red test rather than a silent looseness. Comments (`#`) are skipped,
# so the annotation below each line is documentation, not input.
#
# The shapes are deliberately the *neighbouring* ones — valid except for one
# field. A line that is wrong everywhere ("!!!") tests less than one that is
# right except for the field whose guard is being pinned.

# No scheme at all.
not-a-uri

# Scheme present, credential missing.
vless://

# A UUID-shaped token that is not a UUID: dashes in the wrong places.
vless://uuid-without-dashes@host:443#ok?encryption=none

# A UUID that is not hex. Same guard, different failure.
VLESS://UPPER@host:443#case

# base64 that is not base64. The vmess variant is the one clients actually send,
# so this is the shape a broken subscription produces.
vmess://!!!not-base64!!!

# Same for shadowsocks: the whole payload is one base64 blob.
ss://*

# Scheme but no host and no port.
http://

# A port that is not a number.
vless://host:notaport#x

# A port beyond the legal range.
vless://u@h:99999#port-too-big

# Credentials but nothing to connect to.
trojan://user:pass@#no-host

# Scheme and nothing else.
hysteria2://

# A truncated hysteria2-style URI.
tuic://x

# An IPv6 literal that never closes, which is what reaches the parser when a
# hostname containing `[` is pasted into a config field.
vless://u@[broken:443#x

# Trailing `?` with no query, which a hand-edited link produces.
vless://u@host:443?type=

# A fragment marker with nothing before it and no authority.
#nonsense

# Whitespace only. `parse_one` reports EMPTY rather than raising.
#
